title: What is Wasalt? About Wasalt and its licences
text:
What is Wasalt? About Wasalt: Wasalt is a Saudi-based real estate platform that makes it easier to discover properties, explore opportunities, and connect with property experts across the Kingdom. Whether you are looking to buy, rent, sell, or invest, Wasalt brings the right properties, insights, and services together in one place.
Wasalt describes itself as Saudi Arabia's trusted, AI-backed real estate platform for verified properties and trusted brokers.
Tagline: "Sell, Rent, Buy, or Auction Properties with Wasalt! Explore verified properties, connect with trusted professionals, and find your next opportunity in Saudi Arabia."
Licences shown on the site: REGA (Real Estate General Authority) licensed platform, licence number 1200016591. Ministry of Tourism licensed platform, licence number 73106008, category Accommodation & Unit Reservation. CR number 7017195509.
Payment options shown in the footer include Mada, Visa and Mastercard.

title: Wasalt - services and what you can do on the platform
text:
Wasalt main sections: Listings, Auctions (live), Projects, Support, Post Property, Get Matched.
Search tabs on the homepage: Buy, Rent, Projects, Daily Rentals, and Barter (marked New). Search by city, district and property type.
List your property: Wasalt lets owners list a property for sale or rent quickly, in a few clicks (Post Property).
Daily rentals: owners can list daily rentals with Wasalt, with weekly earnings, free coverage and competitive commission rates (Register Now).
Villas for sale: newly launched villas for sale across Saudi Arabia, with pages for Riyadh, Jeddah, Makkah and Madinah.
Apartments for sale: newly launched apartments for sale across Saudi Arabia, with pages for Riyadh, Jeddah, Makkah and Madinah.
Projects: Wasalt offers verified real-estate projects for investors (Explore Projects).
Get Matched (Matchmaker): customers share their requirements and get connected with relevant property experts.
Auctions: customers can participate in Infath and private auctions across Saudi Arabia covering real estate, vehicles and movable assets.
International luxury properties: Wasalt has an "Explore International Luxury Properties" section with global access, exclusive listings and premium living.
Mobile apps: Wasalt app (selling, buying and renting) and the Wasalt Business app (for professionals to grow their business and connect with clients), each downloadable via QR code or store button.
Languages: English and Arabic.

title: Wasalt - FAQ topics and popular searches
text:
Frequently asked questions listed on Wasalt's homepage (question titles only; answers are on the Wasalt site): What is Wasalt? How can I list my property on Wasalt? How do I log into my Wasalt account? What is Wasalt Auctions? What is Matchmaker, and how does it work? What real estate services does Wasalt offer?
Popular searches on Wasalt cover: properties, villas, apartments and lands for sale or rent in Riyadh, Jeddah, Makkah, Madinah and Dammam, plus Al Khobar and Khamis Mushayt. Popular Riyadh districts include Al Rimal, Al Olaya, Al Yasmeen, Al Khaleej and Al Nakheel.
Other pages linked in the footer: Blogs, About Us, Privacy Policy, Terms of Use, Terms of Advertising.
